chapter: War years, Decca records and La Conga
title: Live broadcasts from La Conga and the theme "Nague"
summary: The band began broadcasting in 1942, opening with "Nague" in a John Bartee arrangement.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Okay. When did you start broadcasting live from La Conga, 1942?
Nineteen forty-two. Do you remember what- the first tune that you played over the air?
It was "Nague". I understand that was your theme song for a while, Right?
What made you pick "Nague" as your theme song?
Because it was, it had a good message.
That's the tune Chano Pozo wrote.
